workUnitId.description: Client-supplied unique identifier for this work unit.

cpt.description: This work unit's Critical Pull Time — drives release priority (earliest CPT first).

reference.description: An external reference this work unit corresponds to (e.g. an order line).

sku.description: OPTIONAL inventory SKU this order line corresponds to, if known. When set, ReleaseNextWork's outbound WorkReleased event carries derived hazmat-capability/fragile hints looked up once from inventory-storage's product classification at release time (see ADR-0009). Omit — or send null, which is treated exactly like omitted — when the SKU is not known to the caller.

giftWrap.description: OPTIONAL. Whether the requester asked the warehouse to produce a gift package for this work unit, stated at enqueue time. This is a caller-stated WorkReleased characteristic, not a product attribute — unlike `sku`, it is never looked up from another service (see ADR-0010). Omit — or send null, which is treated as not requested — when gift wrap was not asked for.
